title: strengthsmpasweapons
description: strength smp as weapons like the strength sword axe and so on and so on
body:
StrengthSMPWeapons

StrengthSMPWeapons is a Paper-exclusive Minecraft plugin that introduces powerful custom weapons inspired by Strength SMP gameplay. Each weapon features unique passive abilities and powerful ultimates, creating exciting PvP combat and rewarding skilled players.

 Features

  Strength Sword

The ultimate weapon for powerful warriors.

Ultimate Ability

duel wield auto crit activated with /swordability
Additional Features

Faster attack speed than axes
Supports dual-wield focused combat styles

---

Strength Axe

Passive Ability

 After landing 5 consecutive critical hits, your target is stunned for 1 second

Ultimate Ability

Activated with r `/axeability`
Your axe deals no damage for 5 seconds
 After the charge-up period, your next attack deals massive burst damage
 2-minute cooldown

---

 Strength Trident

Passive Ability – Storm Strike

Every melee hit summons lightning
Deals 4 bonus damage
Sets enemies on fire
2-second cooldown between strikes

Ultimate Ability – Riding the Wave

Activated with right-click or `/ability`
Requires high Strength levels
Launches you forward
Knocks back all nearby enemies within 8 blocks
90-second cooldown

---

 Strength Bow

Passive Ability

Every 3rd successful shot deals double damage

Ultimate Ability**

Every 10th successful shot deals triple damage

---

 Strength Crossbow

Passive Ability – Grappling Shot

Approximately 33% chance to pull enemies toward you when hit
Pulls targets roughly 1.5 blocks closer

Ultimate Ability – Piercing Shot

Every 10th successful hit deals 4× normal damage

---

 Strength Mace

Included in the plugin and obtainable through commands.
adds a cooldown on the mace (only for the strengthmace)

---

## Commands

| Command             | Description                  |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| /strengthsword      | Obtain the Strength Sword    |
| /strengthaxe        | Obtain the Strength Axe      |
| /strengthtrident    | Obtain the Strength Trident  |
| /strengthmace       | Obtain the Strength Mace     |
| /strengthbow        | Obtain the Strength Bow      |
| /strengthcrossbow   | Obtain the Strength Crossbow |
| /swordability       | Activate the Sword Ultimate  |
| /axeability         | Activate the Axe Ultimate    |

---

## Requirements

* Minecraft Paper Server
* Paper only (Spigot and other server software are not officially supported)
for now this will be only for 1.21.11
